verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators (USB/NFC/BLE security keys). They have no hosted service or production data store, so a sandbox-versus-production test environment is a category error for this product type. The OpenSK hardware lets users 'experience and try FIDO authentications' with custom firmware, but that is a developer board, not an isolated sandbox separating test data from production data. It does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
